candidates.title: Executive Magistrate court orders release of CJP leaders: Ratna Singh
candidates.excerpt: An Executive Magistrate ordered the release of three Cockroach Janata Party leaders detained by Delhi Police ahead of a planned protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The party denied filing a Supreme Court petition and announced another march towards Jantar Mantar

candidates.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee, Detained From Gurugram Home Amid CJP Protest, Released At Night
candidates.excerpt: Dhruv Rathee was detained from his house in Gurugram's Sector 56 yesterday

candidates.title: Trump says Putin wants Ukraine peace deal
candidates.excerpt: US President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin was keen to negotiate an end to the Ukraine war, while accusing Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky of rejecting peace opportunities. Disagreements over Russian diesel exports have further complicated Washington-Kyiv relations

candidates.title: Udupi police arrest two for robbing 74-year-old woman of gold chain
candidates.excerpt: Udupi: Udupi Town Police have arrested two men for allegedly entering the house of a 74-year-old woman living alone and forcibly snatching her gold chain. The police have recovered a gold chain, an electric scooter and two mobile phones worth a total of Rs 5.53 lakh from the accused. The incident occurred on the evening …

candidates.title: Delhi CJP Protest News Live Updates: Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka Released By Court, Dhruv Rathee Also Freed
candidates.excerpt: Delhi CJP Protest Live Updates: Entry and exit gates at 45 Delhi Metro stations, including Rajiv Chowk, New Delhi, Central Secretariat, Patel Chowk and Kashmere Gate, were shut on Saturday.

candidates.title: Nepal To Declare Flood Victims Dead If They Remain Missing For 1.5 Months
candidates.excerpt: The catastrophic flood on August 26 was triggered by a mountain and glacier collapse on the China-Nepal border.

candidates.title: Train Services In Delhi Resume A Day After Cancellations Due To CJP Protest
candidates.excerpt: Indian Railways had decided to cancel Mail and Express trains scheduled to arrive at New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin railway stations between 4 am and 2 pm on October 10.

candidates.title: Flash flood in Nepal’s Bhudi Gandaki River washes away dozens of houses
candidates.excerpt: Flooding in Nepal’s Budhi Gandaki River swept away dozens of houses, bridges and infrastructure in Gorkha district, including a hydropower project camp. No casualties were reported initially, while authorities warned residents to evacuate as water levels exceeded the danger mark

candidates.title: Panama declares state of emergency after powerful quake
candidates.excerpt: Panama declared a state of emergency to coordinate relief operations following a magnitude-7.5 earthquake on October 9 that damaged homes, schools, hospitals and roads. India expressed solidarity with Panama, with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar offering support and condolences
